messages.author: 49ade5cc946993f5
messages.subject: Improve clustering
parts:
Hello!

I am using Cardinal for MALDI image processing. I am doing spatialShrunkenCentroids, and of course I would be happy to obtain spatial clusters resembling actual biological structures actually present in my specimen. However, the clusters don't always look like those structures. Is there a possibility to improve the clustering by removing the peaks with "ugly" distribution, or by using sets of the peaks that have the desired distribution to "train" the set? 

Thank you in advance for the help.

Best regards,
Olga

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Improve clustering
parts:
The segmentation is driven by the data, and sometimes may not exactly reflect visible morphological structures.

You can certainly subset the data to the peaks you wish to use, if you want to create a segmentation from a manually-selected subset of peaks. Just give the method the subsetted dataset.
